approach: When a candidate passes admission in `produce_and_verify` (run.rs), before the verifier snapshot, call a new `EarlyPr` seam. The production impl `GhEarly` (gh.rs) uses GitRemote and GhClient. A pure `early_publish(&dyn Remote, &dyn PrHost, ...)` pushes the candidate to `work_branch(job)`, opens the PR once, stores the PrLink, and stores an early-head marker (pr.rs). It never merges. run.rs logs any error as a warning and ignores it. At landing, the landing commit does not descend from the candidate, so `land_pr` replaces the early head with the landing commit via a new `Remote::replace` (force-with-lease pinned to the marker head) behind the existing `check_replace`. It then clears the marker and reuses the early PR for checks and merge as today.

decisions.choice: New EarlyPr seam held in RunContext; Athena::go keeps its signature and uses GhEarly; new go_with_early takes the seam for tests.
decisions.reason: CLI files are not deliverables and construct Athena literals and call go; RunContext is local to run.rs.

decisions.choice: land_pr replaces the branch head via Remote::replace (lease on early head) when the remote head equals the recorded early head.
decisions.reason: Landing commit is not a descendant of the candidate, so a plain push is refused; a lease pinned to Athena's own push is safe, and check_replace exists.

rejected.option: Make landing commit descend from candidate
rejected.why: Changes landing commit shape; out of scope.

decisions.choice: Early-head marker in a separate state file (pr-early.json), not a PrLink field.
decisions.reason: PrLink literals exist in CLI files outside deliverables; the marker keeps land strict for hand-fixed heads.

decisions.choice: Hook runs synchronously after admission, before the verifier snapshot; all errors become warning lines.
decisions.reason: Only admitted candidates should reach CI; cost is small versus CI minutes; swallowing meets non-fatal requirement.

decisions.choice: On retry with link and marker, replace head with new candidate and do not open another PR; link without marker does nothing.
decisions.reason: One PR per job; never touch a landed or hand-fixed branch.

files.purpose: Add Remote::replace (default bails) and GitRemote lease push; early_publish, EarlyPr trait, GhEarly; land_pr early-head replace; fake-host tests.
Early-head marker helpers store_early/load_early/clear_early with tests.
EarlyPr in RunContext, go_with_early, thread through go_job/dispatch, call after admission before verifier snapshot, go-flow tests.
Entry for early PR open, fingerprint CI caching, non-fatal failures.

steps: pr.rs: add early_path, store_early, load_early, clear_early with a round-trip test.
gh.rs: add Remote::replace with default bail; GitRemote implements it with git push --force-with-lease=refs/heads/<branch>:<expected> <remote> <commit>:refs/heads/<branch>.
gh.rs: add early_publish and EarlyPr trait and GhEarly; never call merge.
gh.rs land_pr: make head mutable; when the early marker matches the remote head and head != landing commit, check_replace, replace, set head, clear marker.
gh.rs tests: FakeRemote replace; early_ tests for push/open/no-merge, failures, early-then-land opening once, hand-fix refusal.
run.rs: add early to RunContext, go_with_early, thread through go_job/dispatch; call after admission before verifier_snapshot, warn and continue on Err.
run.rs tests: recording EarlyPr sharing a log with the fake verifier; ordering and failure-variant equality tests; make existing tests avoid GhEarly.
CHANGELOG.md: add entry in existing format.
Run cargo fmt --all, clippy -D warnings, cargo test --locked.

risks.risk: --force-with-lease weakens the no-replace stance of Remote.
risks.mitigation: replace is reachable only from land_pr and early_publish via check_replace and work_branch, with lease pinned to the marker head.

risks.risk: Early step slows or blocks verification start if gh/git hangs.
risks.mitigation: A few calls versus minutes of CI; errors swallowed; thread later if needed.

risks.risk: Early PR body differs from landing body.
risks.mitigation: Merge text comes from squash, not the PR body.

risks.risk: Existing go tests would call real gh.
risks.mitigation: They use go_with_early with no-op or recording seams; producer checks CLI tests don't reach GhEarly.
Hook runs only after admission; land::plan re-asserts the verified fingerprint.

demonstrations.method: Two tests: gh.rs early_publish with FakeRemote/FakeHost; and a go_with_early test with a recording EarlyPr sharing an event log with the fake verifier.
demonstrations.observes: One push of the candidate sha to athena/<job>, one open_pr, link and marker stored, and the early event precedes the verifier event.
demonstrations.fails_without: With no hook in produce_and_verify there is no early event and the assertion fails; with the hook after the verifier the ordering assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Table test: failure at push, at open_pr, at parse_remote (no origin), and a seam error; each runs the same go_with_early job and compares GoResult state, closing records and outcome with the no-failure run.
demonstrations.observes: Identical outcome in every case, a warning: line shown, and no link stored when open fails.
demonstrations.fails_without: If errors were propagated with ?, the job would fail or go would return Err and the equality assertion against the success run would fail.

demonstrations.method: After early_publish, assert FakeHost merges == 0 and merge_heads empty; merge is requested only in the later land_pr step.
demonstrations.observes: Zero merges from the early step.
demonstrations.fails_without: An early step calling merge would raise FakeHost merges above 0 and the assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: early_publish (candidate C) then land_pr with landing commit L not descending from C, using FakeRemote with replace; plus a hand-fix negative case.
demonstrations.observes: opened == 1 across the sequence, same PR number reported, replace(branch, L, expected C) called, head is L, one merge after the replace, marker cleared; hand-fix head gets today's refusal and no replace.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the replace path land_pr refuses with the 'not the job's landing commit' error; without link reuse opened would be 2.

demonstrations.method: Run the three Athena checks together.
demonstrations.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
demonstrations.observes: All three exit 0 with no warnings; existing land_pr and go tests pass unchanged.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the new code had a formatting difference, a clippy warning, a failing new test, or broke an existing land_pr or go test (for example a go test reaching real GhEarly, or a Remote impl missing replace), one of the three commands would exit nonzero.

demonstrations.observes: A new entry in the existing format saying verification start opens or updates the job's PR so CI caches by fingerprint, that failures are non-fatal, and that landing replaces the early head.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the entry the diff is empty, or lacks the PR-open, fingerprint-caching and non-fatal wording.
